task_definition.task_description: My user ID is u_alice and my email is alice@company.com. First, check the stock price for AAPL, assess the trade risk for an amount of $170.25, and place a buy order at that price. Then, I want to buy some headphones: get collaborative recommendations for the Sony WH-1000XM5 Black (product ID p_sony_xm5_blk) in the electronics category. Hold the best recommendation for 1 unit, confirm the held order, and build my cart items from this selection. Next, get my available coupons, optimize the discount, and generate a payment invoice via Stripe. Once the invoice is generated, snapshot the workspace at '/var/data/workspace' using the invoice ID as the backup name and send a high-priority alert to my email. Finally, build a text report of the snapshot titled 'Daily Backup Report' and email it to me with high priority.

user_input.query:
Hi, my user ID is u_alice and my email is alice@company.com. First, please check the stock price for AAPL, assess the trade risk for an amount of $170.25, and place a buy order at that price. 

Next, I'm looking to buy some headphones. Please get collaborative recommendations for the Sony WH-1000XM5 Black (product ID p_sony_xm5_blk) in the electronics category. Hold the best recommendation for a quantity of 1, confirm the held order, and build my cart items from this selection. After that, check my available coupons, optimize the discount using the code SAVE15, and generate a payment invoice using stripe as the payment gateway. 

Once the invoice is ready, please snapshot my workspace located at /var/data/workspace using the generated invoice ID as the backup name, and send a high priority alert to me via the email channel. Finally, build a text report of the snapshot titled Daily Backup Report and email it to me with high priority.
